subject: Re: Kickoff: soft-attribute semantics for recommender search
body:
Anders,

Resourcing update. Staffing is set: Katya 80%, Yara 70%, Maren 50% through June.

Compute: the CAV fits themselves are cheap, but the full sweep across per-user subjective semantics plus the production embedding refresh is not. Ines confirmed our vulcan-h100 reservation: 256 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-15, which covers the full CAV retraining sweep before the launch review. I deliberately booked ahead of the 6/22-6/24 Vulcan maintenance window so we have slack if runs spill over.

Until then we iterate on titan-a100 best-effort, which is fine for MovieLens-scale runs.

One dependency to flag: we need the SoftAttributes eval harness registered in Evalline; Maren will file the request with Tomas this week.

Jelena
